Culture Clips 3-mavzusining ikkinchi beti. Bosilgan bet raqami: 159.

Betning yuqorisi to'q sariq-oltin rangda, o'rtasidan qizil kamalaksimon chiziq o'tadi. Pastda choy dasturxoni tasvirlangan.

Yuqorida 'Speaking' — ikkita muhokama savoli.

⚠ 158-betdagi 1-mashq uchun kerak bo'lgan A-F RASMLARI AYNAN ShU BETDA:

  A — oq likobchada katta buterbrod: ikki bo'lak qovurilgan non orasida go'sht tilimlari va pishloq, yonida yashil salat va limon
  B — qora naqshli likobchada ikki tilim tost, ustiga sariyog' surtilgan
  C — naqshli uzunchoq likobchada yoyib ochilgan pushti-jigarrang baliq (dudlangan seld), yonida limon tilimi, sariyog' va ko'kat
  D — gulli likobchada qatlamli biskvit tort: bir bo'lagi kesib olingan, ustida oq krem va sariq mevali bo'laklar
  E — gulli naqshli chinni choynak; yonida likobchada to'la piyola choy
  F — likobchada terib qo'yilgan yumaloq jigarrang pechenelar

⚠ Pastki o'ng burchakda yana bir taom bor — panjarali xamirli pirog bo'lagi va sanchqi, LEKIN unga harf berilmagan (mashqda ishtirok etmaydi).

⚠ Bu bet bilan Culture Clips 3-mavzusi tugaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: The pictures (A-F) for exercise 1 on page 158.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠⚠ 158-BETDAGI 1-MAShQ RASMLARI
AYNAN ShU BETDA.

  Kitob savolni bir betga, rasmlarni
  boshqa betga qo'ygan.


OLTITA RASM:

  A  — a sandwich   (buterbrod)
  B  — toast        (tost)
  C  — kippers      (dudlangan seld)
  D  — cake         (tort)
  E  — a pot of tea (bir choynak choy)
  F  — biscuits     (pechene)


⚠ HARFSIZ TAOM HAM BOR:

  Pastki o'ng burchakda panjarali xamirli
  pirog bo'lagi va sanchqi ko'rinadi,
  LEKIN unga harf berilmagan.

  ⚠ Demak u mashqda ishtirok etmaydi —
  faqat dasturxonni to'ldirish uchun
  qo'yilgan.


⚠ NEGA AYNAN ShU OLTITA TAOM:

  158-betdagi matnda hammasi tilga
  olingan:

     'tea is served with a light meal of
      SANDWICHES, BISCUITS, cream CAKES
      or fruit CAKE'

     'foods such as KIPPERS or eggs with
      TOAST ... are served'

     'have a cup of TEA and a biscuit'

  ⚠ Ya'ni rasmlar matnni to'ldiradi.


⚠ CHOY DASTURXONI LUG'ATI:

     a teapot   = choynak
     a cup      = piyola
     a saucer   = likobcha (piyola tagi)
     a plate    = likobcha, tarelka
     a fork     = sanchqi
     a spoon    = qoshiq
     a knife    = pichoq
     a tray     = patnis
     a tablecloth = dasturxon

  ⚠ 'a saucer' va 'a plate' farqi:
     'saucer' — faqat piyola TAGIDAGI
        kichik likobcha
     'plate' — ovqat solinadigan likobcha


⚠ 'KNIFE' — 'K' JIM!

     knife  [nayf]  — 'k' o'qilmaydi
     know   [nou]   — 'k' o'qilmaydi
     knee   [ni:]   — 'k' o'qilmaydi

  ⚠ 'kn-' bilan boshlangan so'zlarda 'k'
  HAR DOIM JIM.

  ⚠ 'knife' ko'pligi ham tartibsiz:
  knife → KNIVES.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a saucer     = likobcha (piyola tagi)
  a plate      = likobcha, tarelka
  a fork       = sanchqi
  a knife      = pichoq
  a tray       = patnis
  a tablecloth = dasturxon
  a slice      = tilim
  butter       = sariyog'
  parsley      = petrushka (ko'kat)

points.en: A - a sandwich: slices of meat and cheese between two pieces of bread, with salad and lemon.
points.uz: A — buterbrod: ikki bo'lak non orasida go'sht tilimlari va pishloq, yonida salat va limon.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a sandwich' ko'pligi 'sandwichES'
('-ch' → '-es').

⚠ So'z Sendvich grafi nomidan olingan:
u qarta o'ynayotib, stoldan turmaslik uchun
nonga go'sht qo'yib yer ekan.

points.en: B - toast: two slices of toasted bread with butter on a black plate.
points.uz: B — tost: qora likobchada sariyog' surtilgan ikki tilim qovurilgan non.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'toast' SANALMAYDI:
  'a slice of toast'  ✓
  'two toasts'        ✗

⚠ 'butter' ham sanalmaydi.

⚠ EHTIYOT: 'to make a toast' — butunlay
boshqa ma'no: qadah so'zi aytmoq!

points.en: C - kippers: a smoked herring, opened flat, with lemon, butter and parsley.
points.uz: C — dudlangan seld: yoyib ochilgan, limon, sariyog' va ko'kat bilan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a kipper' = tuzlangan va dudlangan seld.
Ikkiga yorib, ochib dudlanadi — shuning
uchun rasmda YOYIB qo'yilgan.

⚠ 158-betdagi matnda 'high tea' taomi
sifatida aytilgan.

⚠ 'a herring' = seld baliq.

points.en: D - cake: a layered sponge cake with white cream and fruit.
points.uz: D — tort: oq krem va meva bilan qatlamli biskvit tort.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Matnda ikki xil tort bor:
'CREAM CAKES' (kremli) va 'FRUIT CAKE'
(mevali).

⚠ 'cake' ikki xil:
  'a cake' = butun tort (sanaladi)
  'some cake' = bir bo'lak (sanalmaydi)

⚠ 'a piece of cake' — ibora sifatida
'juda oson ish' degani.

points.en: E - a pot of tea: a china teapot with flowers, and a full cup of tea on a saucer.
points.uz: E — bir choynak choy: gulli chinni choynak va likobchada to'la piyola choy.

points.en: F - biscuits: round brown biscuits arranged on a plate.
points.uz: F — pechene: likobchada terib qo'yilgan yumaloq jigarrang pechenelar.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ BrE 'a biscuit' = PECHENE;
AmE 'a biscuit' = yumshoq bulochka!
AmE da pechene 'a cookie'.

⚠ Matnda: 'have a cup of tea and a BISCUIT'
— aynan 'elevenses' uchun.

⚠ 'to arrange' = terib qo'ymoq.

points.en: There is also a slice of pie and a fork, but they have no letter.
points.uz: Yana bir bo'lak pirog va sanchqi bor, lekin ularga harf berilmagan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Pastki o'ng burchakda panjarali xamirli
pirog bo'lagi ko'rinadi.

⚠ Unga HARF BERILMAGAN — demak mashqda
ishtirok etmaydi, faqat dasturxonni
to'ldirish uchun qo'yilgan.

⚠ Mashq bajarayotganda faqat HARFLI
rasmlarga qarang.

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • Do people in your country drink tea or coffee? What is your national drink?  • Do you have any unusual meals like high tea?
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Sizning mamlakatingizda odamlar choy ichishadimi yoki qahva? Milliy ichimligingiz nima?  • Sizda 'high tea' kabi g'ayrioddiy taomlar bormi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'SPEAKING' — GAPIRISh MAShQI.


BIRINChI SAVOL:
  'Do people in your country drink tea or
   coffee? What is your national drink?'

  ⚠ O'ZBEKISTON UChUN JAVOB:

  Bu savol bizga juda mos keladi — chunki
  O'zbekistonda ham ChOY milliy ichimlik.

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'In Uzbekistan people drink tea. Tea
      is our national drink, just like in
      Britain.

      We drink green tea and black tea. In
      summer people usually drink green
      tea because it is refreshing.

      But there is a big difference: we
      DON'T put milk in our tea. British
      people always add milk and sugar. We
      drink tea from a small bowl called a
      "piyola", not from a cup with a
      handle.

      Tea is very important for guests. When
      someone visits our home, we always
      offer them tea first.'


IKKINChI SAVOL:
  'Do you have any unusual meals like high
   tea?'

  NAMUNA JAVOB:

     'We don't have high tea, but we have
      our own traditions.

      For example, we have "osh" (plov).
      It is a big meal of rice, meat and
      carrots. People often eat it at
      weddings and on special days.

      There is also a tradition called
      "nahorgi osh" - morning plov. People
      eat it very early in the morning,
      at about 6 or 7 o'clock. Hundreds of
      guests come. It is unusual because
      most people don't eat a big meal so
      early!'

  ⚠ 'nahorgi osh' — 'high tea' kabi
  g'ayrioddiy taom: odatdagidan boshqa
  vaqtda yeyiladi. Savolga juda mos javob.


⚠⚠ 'DO YOU HAVE ANY ...?':

  ⚠ SO'ROQ va INKOR gaplarda 'ANY';
  ⚠ TASDIQ gaplarda 'SOME':

     'Do you have ANY unusual meals?'  ✓
     'We have SOME traditions.'        ✓
     'We don't have ANY biscuits.'     ✓


⚠ 'LIKE' — UCh MA'NO:

  1) YOQTIRMOQ (fe'l):
     'I like tea.'

  2) KABI, O'XShASh (predlog):
     'unusual meals LIKE high tea'
     ← bu yerda shu ma'noda

  3) QANAQA (savolda):
     'What is it LIKE?' = U qanaqa?


⚠ 'NATIONAL' — YOZILIShI:

  'nation' (millat) + '-al'

     nation    → national
     tradition → traditional
     culture   → cultural

  ⚠ 'a national drink' = milliy ichimlik


⚠ MUHOKAMA UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'In my country, people usually ...'
  'Our national drink is ...'
  'We have a tradition called ...'
  'It is similar to ... , but ...'
  'The main difference is that ...'
  'For example, ...'


⚠ TAQQOSLASh UChUN:

     'similar to'   = ... ga o'xshash
     'different from' = ... dan farqli
     ⚠ 'different FROM' — 'different than'
     EMAS (Britaniyada).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  national     = milliy
  a nation     = millat
  unusual      = g'ayrioddiy
  usual        = odatdagi
  a difference = farq
  different from = ... dan farqli
  to offer     = taklif qilmoq
  a guest      = mehmon
  refreshing   = tetiklashtiruvchi
  a handle     = dasta

points.en: Do people in your country drink tea or coffee? What is your national drink?
points.uz: Mamlakatingizda odamlar choy ichishadimi yoki qahva? Milliy ichimligingiz nima?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'national' = 'nation' (millat) + '-al'.

⚠ Bu savol bizga juda mos: O'zbekistonda
ham ChOY milliy ichimlik — xuddi
Britaniyadagi kabi.

points.en: In Uzbekistan tea is our national drink, just like in Britain.
points.uz: O'zbekistonda choy — milliy ichimligimiz, xuddi Britaniyadagi kabi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB.

⚠ 'just like' = xuddi ... kabi.

⚠ 158-betdagi 2b mashqida ko'rganimizdek,
'tea' va 'choy' — bir manbadan (xitoy tili),
lekin ikki boshqa yo'l bilan kelgan.

points.en: But there is a big difference: we don't put milk in our tea.
points.uz: Lekin katta farq bor: biz choyga sut solmaymiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ TAQQOSLASH — javobni qiziqarli qiladi.

⚠ 'a difference' (ot) — 'different' (sifat).
⚠ 'different FROM' — 'different than' EMAS
(Britaniyada).

⚠ Britaniyaliklar choyga SUT va ShAKAR
qo'shishadi — 158-betdagi 2c mashqining
5-qadamida shu bor.

points.en: We drink tea from a small bowl called a 'piyola', not from a cup with a handle.
points.uz: Biz choyni dastasi bor piyoladan emas, 'piyola' deb ataladigan kichik kosachadan ichamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan — milliy so'zni
tushuntirish uchun qulay qolip.

⚠ 'a handle' = dasta.

⚠ O'z madaniyatingizni tushuntirganda
shunday qiling: milliy nomni ayting, keyin
ingliz tilida tushuntiring.

points.en: Do you have any unusual meals like high tea?
points.uz: Sizda 'high tea' kabi g'ayrioddiy taomlar bormi?
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'ANY' — SO'ROQ va INKOR gaplarda;
'SOME' — TASDIQ gaplarda.

⚠ 'LIKE' bu yerda 'KABI, O'XSHASH'
ma'nosida (yoqtirmoq EMAS).

⚠ 'unusual' = 'un-' + 'usual'
(odatdagi emas).

points.en: There is a tradition called 'nahorgi osh' - morning plov. People eat it at about 6 or 7 o'clock.
points.uz: 'Nahorgi osh' degan an'ana bor. Odamlar uni ertalab soat 6-7 larda yeyishadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ NAMUNA JAVOB — savolga JUDA MOS.

Nega? Chunki 'high tea' ham, 'nahorgi osh'
ham ODATDAGIDAN BOSHQA VAQTDA yeyiladigan
taom.

⚠ 158-betdagi matnda ishchilar kunini
'at about 6am' boshlashi aytilgan — vaqt
jihatdan qiziq mos kelish.

patterns.formula: In [mamlakat], people drink [ichimlik]. Our national drink is [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: In Uzbekistan people drink tea. Our national drink is tea.
patterns.exampleUz: O'zbekistonda odamlar choy ichishadi. Milliy ichimligimiz — choy.

patterns.exampleEn: There is a tradition called 'nahorgi osh'.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'called' = deb ataladigan.
Milliy so'zni tushuntirishning eng qulay
qolipi.

patterns.formula: It is similar to [nima], but the difference is that ... .
patterns.exampleEn: It is similar to high tea, but the difference is that we eat it in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: U 'high tea' ga o'xshaydi, lekin farqi shundaki, biz uni ertalab yeymiz.

patterns.exampleEn: We don't put milk in our tea. We always offer tea to guests.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz choyga sut solmaymiz. Mehmonlarga doim choy taklif qilamiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'always' — asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN.
⚠ 'don't' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
